question: ______ is a city located on the confluence of river Yamuna and Ganga.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allahabad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Allahabad area known as Prayag is where the Ganga and Yamuna rivers converge or merge.**
 
• **Prayagraj is the present name for Allahabad**, which was formerly known as Kausambi.
 
• It is situated at the **meeting point of the Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati rivers in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of the **oldest towns in the world, Allahabad is revered for its history and religious significance in India.**
 
• **Akbar, the Mughal emperor, had it built in 1583 **and gave it the name Allahabad, which translates to "City of God."
 
• The primary crops in this area are **wheat, barley, and rice.**
 
• The** historic Hindu and Buddhist monuments **of Pratisthanpur and Kausambi are close to Allahabad City.
 
• The **city is also known as Pilgrimage Land, Sangam City, and the City of Prime Ministers, **and it annually hosts the Kumbh Mela.
